invariant.statement: An established cursor installation key is inspected without taking a write lock. Concurrent first creation converges on one 32-byte key through idempotent insertion under state-write admission; successful creation advances the store revision once, while an ignored or refused insert rolls it back. Reads reject missing or incorrectly sized keys and return independent bytes. Production key queries stay in sqlitedb; store adapters retain timestamps and failure envelopes, and cursor consumers retain signing and query-binding policy. Key bytes are authority state and are not agent-response data.
